column1: # The budget and cycle taxonomy (G5, docs/trust.md clause 2): three
# different answers -- "your model is cyclic", "your model is
# incomplete", and "my budget ran out" -- must never collapse into one
# message. An agent branches on the class: path_cycle (reference) means
# FIX THE MODEL, no_path (reference) means SUPPLY MORE, budget_passes /
# unify_cycle (budget) mean THE EVALUATOR GAVE UP and a larger budget
# may (only for these) be a valid response.
# Columns: name<TAB>mode<TAB>src<TAB>expect ; modes: errc|err ; escapes: \n \t \\
# A PROVEN cycle is path_cycle wherever the proof comes from: a
# self/ancestor reference (peg is a prefix of the node's own path), or
# the resolution chain of plain references revisiting a node (mutual
# and longer chains -- detectRefCycle in ts/src/val/RefVal.ts and
# go/ref.go). A chain that passes through a variable segment, a
# conjunct, a function, or any non-ref value yields NO proof and defers
# as before.
path-cycle-self
path-cycle-ancestor
path-cycle-mutual
path-cycle-chain
path-cycle-nested-mutual
path-cycle-msg
# Mere incompleteness stays no_path: the model is wrong about a name,
# not cyclic and not out of budget.
no-path
no-path-msg

column1: # budget_passes -- the pass loop finished its budget (maxcc = 9,
# ts/src/unify.ts; go/unify.go) with the final pass STILL MAKING
# PROGRESS (the model was cut off while converging) and no other
# error. A STABLE residue -- a stuck `1+true`, an unresolved kind --
# is ordinary incompleteness, stays silent at unify, and surfaces at
# generate as before; only genuine cut-off earns the budget code. The
# code is registered (errcodes.tsv, class budget, message substring
# "evaluation budget") and BOTH engines emit it at the pass-loop exit
# -- but no shared row can pin it yet: the smallest reproducer (a
# chain of 10 plain refs) exhausts the budget in TypeScript and
# resolves eagerly in Go, an OPEN verdict divergence tracked in
# divergent.tsv (issue #26). A shared row lands when that decision
# does.
# unify_cycle -- the per-pair revisit bound (MAXCYCLE = 999,
# ts/src/unify.ts) tripping: SUSPECTED non-convergence. No known small
# reproducer exists (small cycles are all caught earlier as
# path_cycle), and the bound's acknowledged false positive ("too many
# top unifications", ts/src/unify.ts TODO) needs a generated-SDK-scale
# corpus before its behaviour is pinned or changed -- G5 phase 2's
# remaining slice.
